en.title: Zheng Qinwen reaches China Open women's singles final for first time, sets best record for Chinese player at tournament
en.summary: Chinese tennis player Zheng Qinwen defeated Belgium's Elise Mertens 7-5, 6-2 in the women's singles semifinal to reach her first China Open final. She became the first player to reach the women's singles final on a wildcard and the first Chinese player to reach a singles final at the tournament.
